<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<addon id="plugin.video.xtreammate"
       name="XCMate"
       version="0.1.29.77"
       provider-name="GS Media">

  <requires>
    <import addon="xbmc.python" version="3.0.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.pil" version="5.1.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.requests" version="2.27.0" optional="true"/>

</requires>

  <extension point="xbmc.python.pluginsource" library="default.py">
    <provides>video audio</provides>
  </extension>

  <extension point="xbmc.service" library="service.py" start="startup"/>

  <extension point="xbmc.addon.metadata">
    <summary lang="en_GB">XCMate – TV setup wizard for Xtream, M3U and Stalker</summary>
    <summary lang="de_DE">XCMate – IPTV-Einrichtungsassistent mit Xtream, M3U und Stalker</summary>
    <description lang="en_GB">
      Independent GPL-licensed derivative of mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi, featuring a guided IPTV import process and on-video remote-control live channel and category navigation.
      Features: Multiple M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API (Live/VOD/Series),
      XMLTV EPG, channel groups, favourites, search, catch-up, recordings,
      reminders, sleep timer.
    </description>
    <description lang="de_DE">
      Eigenständiger GPL-Fork von mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi mit geführter IPTV-Einrichtung und Fernbedienungssteuerung über laufendem Live-TV.
      Funktionen: Mehrere M3U-Playlists, Xtream-Codes-API (Live/VOD/Serien),
      XMLTV-EPG, Sendergruppen, Favoriten, Suche, Catch-up, Aufnahmen,
      Erinnerungen, Sleep-Timer.
    </description>
    <platform>all</platform>
    <license>GPL-2.0-only</license>
    <defaultlanguage>resource.language.en_gb</defaultlanguage>
    <forum>https://forum.kodi.tv</forum>
    <website>https://kodi.tv</website>
    <source>https://github.com/artattakk-creator/kodi-noodleprivate</source>
    <news>0.1.29.77 Pilot: automatische EPG-Bildquellen mit vorhandenem Token, vollständige Bildprüfung und Cache-Erneuerung; Serien-/Film-Exit mit nativer ACK-Barriere; Space-Blue-kompatible Home-Vorschau. Token, Passwörter, EPG und Einstellungen bleiben erhalten. Sichtbare Android-Bild-/Exit-Abnahme noch offen.</news>
    <assets>
      <icon>icon-81da1003a2753ec6.png</icon>
      <fanart>resources/media/lightweight_splash.jpg</fanart>
    </assets>
  </extension>

</addon>

src/plugin.video.xtreammate/changelog.tx.old:
0.1.29.77 (Pilot-Test, #380 / #366 / #367 / #368)
- Vorhandenen gültigen TMDB-Token read-only übernehmen und Lookup einmalig freischalten; TVMaze-Serienfallback automatisch, bewusste Opt-outs erhalten.
- Vollständige Bilddekodierung vor Freigabe, geprüfte Redirects und begrenzte Erneuerung abgelaufener Event-URL-Leases; negative Caches nach Quellfreigabe erneut prüfen.
- Serien-/Film-Exit: Fortschritt vorab sichern, Android-Vollbild kontrolliert freigeben, genau ein nativer Stop mit FIFO-ACK; keine Player-Abfragen während unbestätigtem Stop.
- Bekannte Space-Blue-Home-Variante exakt unterstützen; Vorschau, Sicherung und Zustimmung erhalten, Hero-Bild flächig bei unveränderter Geometrie. Fehlende Controls separat diagnostizieren.
- EPG-Lesezugriffe kurz und generationsgebunden zusammenfassen; fehlende Kodi-Bibliotheksviews nur diagnostizieren.
- Installer 0.5.26, Profile, Passwörter, Token, EPG-Zuordnungen und Originalgrafiken unverändert. Android-P0-Abnahme ausdrücklich noch offen.

0.1.29.76 (unveröffentlichter Testkandidat, Folgeauftrag zu #367)
- Verifizierte Bild- oder neutrale Fallback-Vorbereitung gibt die nächste Hintergrundphase frei, ohne unsichtbare Leisten als gerendert zu melden.
- Reihenfolge Live-TV → Filme → Serien bleibt erhalten; keine neue Warteschlange oder Änderung an Widgets, Routing, Player und Nutzerdaten.
- Veraltete Veröffentlichungen erneut bereitstellen; leere bestätigte Kataloge und deaktivierte Bereiche blockieren die Folgephase nicht. Android-Abnahme ausstehend.

0.1.29.75 (Pilot-Test, Issues #366 / #367 / #368)
- Start-EPG: lokaler Now/Next-Checkpoint ohne vorherigen Senderstart; vorhandene Texte und Logos bei kurzen Lesefehlern erhalten.
- Optionaler BINGIE-Adapter: großes Bild links, feste Informationstabelle rechts und eine aktive Sender-/Cover-Leiste; Vorschau, Sicherung und Zustimmung bleiben erforderlich.
- Senderfokus und sichtbare fünf Programme vorrangig; neue automatische Film-/Serienarbeit an native Rendernachweise binden.
- Exakte XMLTV-/Provider-Eventbilder nach sicherer HTTPS-/DNS-/Bildprüfung auch ohne manuelle CDN-Hostliste; bestehende TMDB-/TVmaze-Freigaben unverändert.
- Live-TV-Stop: zusätzliche 5-/10-Sekunden-ACK-Diagnose ohne zweiten Stop oder falsche Erfolgsmeldung. Nativer RK3528-Hänger weiterhin auf Android zu prüfen.
- Portale, Passwörter, EPG, TMDB-Zugang, Favoriten, Widgets, Space Blue und bestehende Bilder bleiben erhalten. Kein Reset.

0.1.29.74 (Test-Build, Issue #361)
- Home: Titelbestand und Bildfreigabe trennen; gültige Cover und Jetzt/Danach bei kurzen Lesefehlern erhalten.
- Atomare Widgetgenerationen, weniger identische Veröffentlichungen und lokales EPG-Nachladen ohne Fokusblockade.
- Drei Standardwidgets direkt auswählen; bestehende Verknüpfungen, Portale, Passwörter und Einstellungen bleiben erhalten.
- Sendungsbilder: Quellenfreigaben beachten, optionale Verbindungstests und größere Vorschau im großen EPG.
- Optionaler BINGIE-Fokusadapter nur nach Vorschau, Sicherung und ausdrücklicher Zustimmung; Android-Abnahme ausstehend.

0.1.29.73 (Test-Build, Issues #357 / #358 / #359)
- Gesamten Katalog im Hintergrund aktualisieren: Live-TV, Filme, Serien und optional EPG; Abbruch und Fortsetzung.
- Fehlende Kategorien gezielt nachfordern und gruppenbezogenen Importstatus anzeigen; Sicherung und frischer Datenbank-Readback.
- Gespeicherte BINGIE-Widgetverknüpfungen diagnostizieren und vorhandene Home-Konfiguration ausdrücklich neu aufbauen.
- Internationale EPG-Kandidaten standardmäßig aus; geprüfte Quellen nur nach bewusster Aktivierung. Quellen-/Nutzungsprüfung teils noch offen.
- 17 Sprachvarianten für neue Abläufe und Kernnavigation; ältere Dialoge teilweise Englisch-Fallback. Portale, Passwörter, EPG und Widgets bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.72 (Test-Build, Issue #355)
- Katalog aktualisieren: Filme und Serien im bestehenden Provider sicher nachscannen.
- Echte Remote-Abfrage mit klarer Diagnose für leere, fehlerhafte und unvollständige Anbieterantworten.
- Inkrementeller Titelabgleich, private Sicherung, geprüfter Readback und Abbruch ohne Teilgruppen.
- Live-TV, EPG, Favoriten, Serienfortschritt und gespeicherte Zugangsdaten bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.71 (Test-Build, Issue #352)
- Einrichtung: Android-App-Speicher gezielt prüfen; lokale Checkpoint-Fehler nicht als Netzwerkfehler melden.
- Sendergruppen und ausdrücklich gewählte Startgruppe mit Sicherung und frischem Readback speichern.
- Alte Playlists einmal atomar übernehmen; keine selbst wiederholende Verzeichnis-Aktualisierung.
- Diagnose mit anonymem Sitzungscode, errno, sicheren Stackpositionen und freiem Speicher am Kodi-Datenpfad.
- Portale, Passwörter, EPG, TMDB, Favoriten, Medienfortschritte und vorhandene Komponenten bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.70 (Test-Build)

0.1.29.56

0.1.29.54
- Installation erfolgreich: Popup zeigt installierte Version und konkrete Änderungen.
- Wizard prüft die Verbindung getrennt und bestätigt gültige Zugangsdaten.
- Geprüfte Kataloggruppen inkrementell sichern und beim Retry wiederverwenden.

0.1.29.53

- 24 Stunden Standardrefresh; bestehende Intervalle und LastGood bleiben erhalten.
- Gezielte, begrenzte Quellen-Retries statt permanentem Überspringen oder Voll-Neustart.
- Wiederaufnehmbarer Wizard mit privaten Zwischenständen, Zurück, Retry und bestätigtem Verwerfen.

- .50/.52-Widgets und Pixelanzeige erhalten; BINGIE-Skinpatch nur separat freigegeben.

0.1.29.52

- Gerahmte echte Stream-Pixelauflösung; Übergangswerte bleiben unbekannt.

0.1.29.51

0.1.29.50 (explicit BINGIE Home integration; Android NOT_TESTED)

"""Bounded visible-image approval/cache; no external filesystem/DNS on GUI.

Dynamic mode passes approved provider URLs to Kodi's texture loader. XCMate
never downloads/archives them; Kodi may cache textures itself. Public-address
DNS validation is background-only, cached briefly, with no provider URL logs.
"""
import collections
import ipaddress
import queue
import socket
import threading
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

_lock=threading.Lock();_values=collections.OrderedDict();_pending=set();_revision=0
_queues={'dynamic':queue.Queue(maxsize=128),'external':queue.Queue(maxsize=128)}
_threads={}
_dns_cache=collections.OrderedDict()
KODI_OPTIONS='|redirect-limit=0&connection-timeout=3&failonerror=true'


def syntactic(url):
    from media_art import valid_source
    if not valid_source(url) or '\\' in url or '|' in url:return False
    try:
        p=urlsplit(url)
        if p.username is not None or p.password is not None:return False
        if p.hostname.lower()=='localhost' or p.hostname.lower().endswith(('.localhost','.local','.internal')):return False
        try:return ipaddress.ip_address(p.hostname).is_global
        except ValueError:return '.' in p.hostname
    except (ValueError,AttributeError):return False


def public_dns(url):
    if not syntactic(url):return False
    p=urlsplit(url);key=(p.hostname,p.port or (443 if p.scheme=='https' else 80))
    with _lock:
        prior=_dns_cache.get(key)
        if prior and prior[0]>time.monotonic()+(10 if prior[1] else 0):return prior[1]
    try:
        values=socket.getaddrinfo(key[0],key[1],type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        approved=bool(values) and all(ipaddress.ip_address(value[4][0]).is_global for value in values)
    except (OSError,ValueError):approved=False
    with _lock:
        _dns_cache[key]=(time.monotonic()+(30 if approved else 5),approved)
        _dns_cache.move_to_end(key)
        while len(_dns_cache)>128:_dns_cache.popitem(last=False)
    return approved


def _process(kind,key,payload):
    if kind=='dynamic':
        approved=public_dns(payload)
        return payload+KODI_OPTIONS if approved else ''
    storage,ident=payload
    from artwork_vfs import image_valid
    data=storage.read(ident,65536)
    return storage.make_display_uri(ident) if image_valid(data) else ''


def _run(kind):
    global _revision
    work=_queues[kind]
    while True:
        try:key,payload=work.get(timeout=2)
        except queue.Empty:
            with _lock:
                if work.empty():_threads.pop(kind,None);return
            continue
        try:
            try:value=_process(kind,key,payload)
            except Exception:value=''
            with _lock:
                fresh=key not in _values
                previous=_values.get(key,(0,''))[1]
                expires=time.monotonic()+(30 if value else 5)
                if kind=='dynamic' and value:
                    parsed=urlsplit(payload);dns=_dns_cache.get((parsed.hostname,parsed.port or (443 if parsed.scheme=='https' else 80)))
                    if not dns or not dns[1]:value=''
                    else:expires=min(expires,dns[0])
                _values[key]=(expires,value)
                _values.move_to_end(key);_pending.discard(key)
                if previous!=value:_revision+=1
                while len(_values)>512:_values.popitem(last=False)
            if kind=='dynamic' and (fresh or previous!=value):
                from art_diagnostics import publish
                publish('transfer','DYNAMIC_URL_APPROVED' if value else 'DYNAMIC_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE')
        finally:work.task_done()


def lookup(kind,key,payload):
    with _lock:
        value=_values.get(key)
        now=time.monotonic()
        # Revalidate ten seconds before expiry; never extend DNS approval TTL.
        if value and value[0]>now+(10 if value[1] else 0):return value[1]
        if key not in _pending:
            try:_queues[kind].put_nowait((key,payload));_pending.add(key)
            except queue.Full:return value[1] if value and value[0]>now else ''
        thread=_threads.get(kind)
        if thread is None or not thread.is_alive():
            thread=threading.Thread(target=_run,args=(kind,),name='XCMate-visible-'+kind,daemon=True)
            _threads[kind]=thread;thread.start()
        return value[1] if value and value[0]>now else ''


def dynamic(url):
    if not syntactic(url):return ''
    return lookup('dynamic',('dynamic',url),url)


def external(storage,ident):
    return lookup('external',('external',storage.resolve_target(),ident),(storage,ident))


def revision():
    with _lock:return _revision


def retain_displayed(item,prior,current):
    """Keep an already displayed texture while its exact URL is pending.

    This does not admit an expired URI to a new item. Definitive DNS failure
    removes pending and forces the placeholder; no TTL/security bypass.
    """
    from artwork_config import persistent
    if persistent():return current
    from media_art import sources
    poster,fanart=sources(item);result=dict(current)
    with _lock:
        for url,fields in ((poster,('poster','thumb','icon','landscape')),(fanart,('fanart','landscape'))):
            if url and ('dynamic',url) in _pending:
                approved=_values.get(('dynamic',url),(0,''))[1]
                if approved==url+KODI_OPTIONS:
                    for field in fields:
                        if prior.get(field)==approved:result[field]=approved
    return result

"""Single-flight Stop dispatcher. Native callbacks only publish intent.

The service starts one daemon worker after window release; SQLite/native Stop
never run inside the GUI callback or block the service watchdog. A stuck native
Stop cannot be forcibly cancelled: report TIMEOUT, never replay or stop foreign
playback. The real Android freeze cause remains unverified without new logs.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import threading
import time

KEY='XCMate.PlaybackExit37'
_thread=None
_lock=threading.Lock()


def state():
    import xbmcgui
    try:
        value=json.loads(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(KEY))
        if not isinstance(value,dict):return None
        token=value.get('token')
        from playback_exit import _session
        if not isinstance(token,list) or len(token)!=2 or token[0] not in ('live','media') or not _session(json.dumps(token[1])):return None
        if value.get('phase') in ('pending','running','complete','failed','timeout') and 0<=time.time()-value.get('at',0)<86400:
            return value
    except (ValueError,TypeError):pass
    return None


def save(value):
    import xbmcgui
    xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(KEY,json.dumps(value))


REASONS=('USER_STOP','USER_BACK','USER_HOME','FULLSCREEN_EXIT','OWNER_CHANGED',
         'AUTOPLAY_CANCEL','PLAYBACK_ENDED','STARTUP_ABORT')


def blocked():
    '''No player mutex queries/retry while a native Stop may still be running.

    The Window property survives different plugin/service interpreters. Timeout
    is an observation, not permission to launch a second native Stop.
    '''
    value=state()
    return bool(value and (value['phase'] in ('pending','running') or
                value.get('stop_started') and not value.get('worker_done') or
                value.get('prepare_posted42') and not value.get('prepare_done42') or
                value.get('prepare_posted77') and not value.get('prepare_ready77') or
                value.get('checkpoint_started77') and not value.get('checkpoint_done77')))


def trace(stage,token,reason=None):
    import xbmc,xbmcgui
    digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([token[0],token[1].get('nonce')]).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]

import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from localization import tr
KINDS=((32401,'live'),(32403,'vod'),(32404,'series'))
ERRORS={'PROFILE_BUDGET','INVALID_SOURCE','SINGLE_WIDGET_HOME','UNVERIFIED_SKIN_VERSION','UNVERIFIED_SHORTCUTS_VERSION','UNSUPPORTED_SKIN','PLAYER_ACTIVE','NATIVE_EDITOR_BUSY','NO_SAVED_BINGIE_PROFILE','UNVERIFIED_MENU_SHARING','HOME_ID_UNVERIFIED','INVALID_PROPERTIES','DUPLICATE_PROPERTIES','OCCUPIED_SLOT','UNSAFE_BACKUP_FOLDER','UNSAFE_TARGET','UNSAFE_PLAN','BACKUP_VERIFY_FAILED','TARGET_CHANGED_NO_OVERWRITE','TARGET_VERIFY_FAILED','CANDIDATE_VERIFY_FAILED','PROFILE_CHANGED','SKIN_CHANGED','UNVERIFIED_SKIN_FILE','UNVERIFIED_TEMPLATE','UNVERIFIED_OVERRIDES','UNVERIFIED_HERO_REGION','UNVERIFIED_FONTS','PLAN_BUSY'}


def runtime():
    import xbmc,xbmcaddon,xbmcgui,xbmcvfs
    if xbmc.getSkinDir()!='skin.titan.bingie.mod':raise ValueError('UNSUPPORTED_SKIN')
    skin=xbmcaddon.Addon('skin.titan.bingie.mod');shortcuts=xbmcaddon.Addon('script.skinshortcuts')
    if skin.getAddonInfo('version')!='2.2.3':raise ValueError('UNVERIFIED_SKIN_VERSION')
    if shortcuts.getAddonInfo('version')!='2.1.0':raise ValueError('UNVERIFIED_SHORTCUTS_VERSION')
    if xbmc.getCondVisibility('Player.HasMedia'):raise ValueError('PLAYER_ACTIVE')
    if xbmc.getCondVisibility('Window.IsVisible(script-skinshortcuts.xml)') or xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty('skinshortcuts-isrunning')=='True':raise ValueError('NATIVE_EDITOR_BUSY')
    return Path(xbmcvfs.translatePath('special://profile/')).resolve(),Path(skin.getAddonInfo('path')).resolve()


def rebuild():
    import xbmc,xbmcgui
    xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('skinshortcuts-reloadmainmenu','True')
    # Same entry point as BINGIE 2.2.3 Home.xml. Native builder reloads only
    # after a successful build; never reset its hashes, settings or cache.
    xbmc.executebuiltin('RunScript(script.skinshortcuts,type=buildxml&mainmenuID=900&group=mainmenu|powermenu)')


def trace(event,kind='',slot=0):
    if event not in ('BINDING_SAVED','SKIN_PATCH_VERIFIED','RESTORED'):return
    import xbmc
    try:xbmc.log('[XCMate][WIDGET50] event='+event+' kind='+(kind if kind in ('live','vod','series') else 'skin')+' slot='+str(int(slot)),xbmc.LOGINFO)
    except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):pass


def error(exc):
    import xbmc,xbmcgui
    code=str(exc) if str(exc) in ERRORS else 'LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE'
    xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36410,code))
    if code in ('NO_SAVED_BINGIE_PROFILE','HOME_ID_UNVERIFIED','SINGLE_WIDGET_HOME'):
        if xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno('XCMate',tr(36428),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36429),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):
            runtime()
            xbmc.executebuiltin('RunScript(script.skinshortcuts,type=manage&group=mainmenu)')


def show(router,portal):
    if router._params.get('shortcuts62') in ('check','restore'):
        from boot_diagnostics import finish_directory
        finish_directory(router,succeeded=False,cacheToDisc=False)
        from shortcuts62 import show as compatibility
        compatibility(restore=router._params['shortcuts62']=='restore');return
    if router._handle<0:
        import xbmc
        xbmc.executebuiltin('ActivateWindow(Videos,'+router.url(action='widget_setup',pid=portal['id'],**({'technical74':'1'} if router._params.get('technical74')=='1' else {})) +',return)');return
    import xbmcgui,xbmcplugin
    from menu_icons45 import icon
    from boot_diagnostics import finish_directory
    xbmcplugin.setContent(router._handle,'files');xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(router._handle,tr(32443))
    for label,kind in KINDS:
        item=xbmcgui.ListItem(tr(label));item.setProperty('IsPlayable','false')
        item.setInfo('video',dict(title=tr(label),plot=tr(36400)))
        image=icon({'live':'home_live','vod':'movies_home','series':'series_home'}[kind]);item.setArt(dict(icon=image,thumb=image))
        menus=[(tr(36401),'RunPlugin('+router.url(action='widget_skin50',pid=portal['id'])+')'),
               (tr(36402),'RunPlugin('+router.url(action='widget_restore50',pid=portal['id'])+')'),
               (tr(36303),'RunPlugin('+router.url(action='widget_manage49',pid=portal['id'])+')'),
               (tr(36403),'ActivateWindow(Videos,'+router.url(action='widget_sources49',pid=portal['id'])+',return)')]
        item.addContextMenuItems(menus)
        xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(router._handle,router.url(action='widget_link50',pid=portal['id'],kind=kind),item,isFolder=False)
    for label,action in ((36613,'widget_skin50'),(36402,'widget_restore50')):
        item=xbmcgui.ListItem(tr(label));item.setProperty('IsPlayable','false')
        item.setInfo('video',dict(title=tr(label),plot=tr(36612)))
        item.setArt(dict(icon=icon('widget_setup')))
        xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(router._handle,router.url(action=action,pid=portal['id']),item,isFolder=False)
    for label,mode in ((36641,'check'),(36642,'restore')):
        item=xbmcgui.ListItem(tr(label));item.setProperty('IsPlayable','false')
        xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(router._handle,router.url(action='widget_setup',pid=portal['id'],shortcuts62=mode),item,isFolder=False)

def link(router,portal):
    import xbmcgui
    from menu_icons45 import select
    from widget_binding50 import context,options,prepare,apply
    from widget_skin50 import applied
    try:
        profile,skin=runtime();kind=router._params.get('kind','')
        if kind not in ('live','vod','series'):raise ValueError('INVALID_SOURCE')
        if kind=='live' and not applied(skin):
            if xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno('XCMate',tr(36404),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36401),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):skin_setup()
            return
        ctx=context(profile,skin);choices=options(ctx,kind,portal['id'])
        already=[v for v in choices if v['state']=='ALREADY_LINKED']
        if already:
            from widget_repair73 import existing
            existing(profile,skin,kind,portal['id'],already[0]['slot'])
            return
        choices=[v for v in choices if v['state']!='ALREADY_LINKED']
        if not choices:xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36407));return
        labels=[tr(36408,v['slot']+1)+(' · '+tr(36409) if v['state']=='UPGRADE_OWN_LIVE' else '') for v in choices]
        choice=select(xbmcgui.Dialog(),tr(36411),labels,default='grid')
        if not isinstance(choice,int) or not 0<=choice<len(choices):return
        label=tr(dict((kind,label) for label,kind in KINDS)[kind]);plan=prepare(ctx,kind,portal['id'],choices[choice]['slot'],label)
        if plan.get('code')=='ALREADY_LINKED':return
        entries=plan['entries'];message=tr(36412,label,choices[choice]['slot']+1,entries[0]['before'],entries[0]['after'])
        xbmcgui.Dialog().textviewer(tr(36411),message)
        if not xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno(tr(36413),tr(36427,label,choices[choice]['slot']+1),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36414),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
        current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
        apply(plan['id'],current_profile,current_skin,confirmed=True)
        trace('BINDING_SAVED',kind,choices[choice]['slot']+1)
        rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36415))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RuntimeError,ET.ParseError) as exc:error(exc)


def skin_setup():
    import xbmcgui
    from widget_skin50 import prepare,apply,applied,FILES
    try:
        profile,skin=runtime()
        if applied(skin):
            # Never reapply or rebuild on opening this directory. Recovery of a
            # stale generated include is a separate, explicit user action.
            xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36416))
            if xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno('XCMate',tr(36614),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36615),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):
                current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
                if current_profile!=profile or current_skin!=skin:raise ValueError('PROFILE_CHANGED')
                rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36415))
            return
        plan=prepare(skin)
        names75=list(FILES)+(['xml/IncludesBingie.xml'] if len(plan['entries'])==5 else [])
        hashes='\n'.join(name+'\n'+e['before']+' → '+e['after'] for name,e in zip(names75,plan['entries']))
        from widget_skin60 import preview
        xbmcgui.Dialog().textviewer(tr(36401),tr(36417)+'\n\n'+hashes+'\n\n'+preview(plan))
        if not xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno(tr(36413),tr(36418),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36419),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
        current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
        if current_profile!=profile or current_skin!=skin:raise ValueError('PROFILE_CHANGED')
        apply(plan['id'],skin,confirmed=True);trace('SKIN_PATCH_VERIFIED');rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36415))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RuntimeError,ET.ParseError) as exc:error(exc)


def restore():
    import xbmcgui
    from menu_icons45 import select
    from widget_transaction50 import folder,load
    try:
        profile,skin=runtime();plans=[]
        for p in folder().iterdir():
            if not p.is_dir() or len(p.name)!=32:continue
            try:
                for kind in ('binding','skin'):
                    try:plan=load(p.name,kind)
                    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError):continue
                    status=json.loads((p/'state.json').read_text()).get('state')
                    if status in ('APPLIED','APPLYING','INTERRUPTED','RESTORING'):plans.append(plan)
                    break
            except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError):pass
        plans.sort(key=lambda p:p.get('at',0),reverse=True)
        labels=[tr(36421 if p['kind']=='skin' else 36420)+' · '+p['id'][:8] for p in plans]
        if not labels:xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',tr(36422));return
        choice=select(xbmcgui.Dialog(),tr(36402),labels,default='shield')
        if not isinstance(choice,int) or not 0<=choice<len(plans):return
        plan=plans[choice]
        if not xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno(tr(36402),tr(36423),nolabel=tr(36426),yeslabel=tr(36424),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
        current_profile,current_skin=runtime()
        if current_profile!=profile or current_skin!=skin:raise ValueError('PROFILE_CHANGED')
        if plan['kind']=='binding':
            from widget_binding50 import apply
            apply(plan['id'],profile,skin,confirmed=True,restore=True)
        else:
            from widget_skin50 import apply
            apply(plan['id'],skin,confirmed=True,restore=True)
        trace('RESTORED');rebuild();xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',tr(36425))
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,RuntimeError,ET.ParseError) as exc:error(exc)

"""Publish local pages and notify existing native skin directory reload hooks.

No skin writes, shortcut rebinding, global refresh, library scan or focus IO.
Worker writes a bounded atomic DTO; the service GUI pump changes only runtime
reload properties already referenced by verified own widget source URLs. Kodi
retains its DirectoryProvider and exact native click behavior. Missing hooks
are explicitly blocked until an optional separately confirmed adapter is used.
"""
import hashlib,json,os,tempfile,time
MAX_BYTES=16*1024*1024
_next=0;_seen={};_last_code={};_art_cursor46={}


def trace(code,kind='',rows=0):
    if code not in ('PUBLISHED','UPDATED','UNCHANGED','NO_BINDING','UNSUPPORTED_CONTROL','READ_ERROR','DEFERRED','BAD_FRAME','BLOCKED_NO_RELOAD_HOOK'):return
    state=(code,kind,rows)
    if _last_code.get(kind)==state:return
    _last_code[kind]=state
    try:
        import xbmc
        xbmc.log('[XCMate][WIDGET45] code='+code+' kind='+(kind if kind in ('live','vod','series') else 'all')+' rows='+str(max(0,rows)),xbmc.LOGINFO)
    except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):pass


def path(pid,kind):
    from utils import addon_data_dir
    return os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'widget45_'+hashlib.sha256((str(pid)+'|'+kind).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]+'.json')


def read(pid,kind):
    try:
        with open(path(pid,kind),encoding='utf-8') as f:raw=f.read(MAX_BYTES+1)
        if len(raw)>MAX_BYTES:return None
        frame=json.loads(raw)
        if not isinstance(frame,dict) or frame.get('pid')!=str(pid) or frame.get('kind')!=kind:return None
        if not isinstance(frame.get('at'),(int,float)) or not 0<=time.time()-frame['at']<600:return None
        if kind=='live' and isinstance(frame.get('pages46'),list):
            from widget_pages46 import Items
            pages=frame['pages46']
            if (not isinstance(frame.get('count46'),int) or frame['count46']<=0
                    or not pages or any(not isinstance(p,dict) or not isinstance(p.get('count'),int) or not 0<p['count']<=16 for p in pages)
                    or sum(p['count'] for p in pages)!=frame['count46']):return None
            values=frame['items']=Items(path(pid,kind),frame)
        else:
            values=frame.get('items')
            if not isinstance(values,list) or not values and not frame.get('empty_authoritative74') or kind!='live' and len(values)>24:return None
        from urllib.parse import urlsplit,parse_qs
        for value in values:
            if not isinstance(value,dict) or not all(isinstance(value.get(k),dict) for k in ('props','art','info')) or not isinstance(value.get('label'),str):return None
            props=value['props'];q=parse_qs(urlsplit(value.get('url','')).query)
            if props.get('XCMate.PortalId')!=str(pid) or props.get('XCMate.WidgetKind41')!=kind:return None
            if q.get('pid')!=[str(pid)] or q.get('sid')!=[props.get('XCMate.MediaId')]:return None
            parsed=urlsplit(value['url'])
            if parsed.scheme!='plugin' or parsed.netloc!='plugin.video.xtreammate':return None
            allowed=('play_live','source_play') if kind=='live' else ('media_detail',)
            if q.get('action',[''])[0] not in allowed or (kind!='live' and q.get('kind')!=[kind]):return None
        return frame
    except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,AttributeError):return None
